claim: Incremental downstream pneumothorax utility of private-role synthetic data, then preservation under patient DP and full cost comparison

synthetic.labels: requested conditions, not expert ground truth

prompts.pneumothorax: a frontal posteroanterior chest radiograph with radiographic findings of pneumothorax
prompts.normal: a frontal posteroanterior chest radiograph with no labeled finding
prompts.effusion: a frontal posteroanterior chest radiograph with radiographic findings of pleural effusion
prompts.cardiomegaly: a frontal posteroanterior chest radiograph with radiographic findings of cardiomegaly

classifier.selection: public R1 only on classifier_selection; AUROC tie within .002 prefers fewer steps then lower lr
classifier.real_sampling: uniform patient within class, then uniform image within patient/class
classifier.input: full frame aspect-preserving letterbox224 then ImageNet normalization; no center crop
classifier.augmentation: affine rotation5deg translation.02 scale[.95,1.05], no flips
classifier.real_repeat: same fixed-step sampling distribution as R1, not a separate efficacy arm

development_investment_rule.scope: engineering investment criterion, not clinical margin, significance or final efficacy criterion

DP.accounting: must be recalibrated and independently checked
DP.release: individual mechanism guarantee; entire public-data research bundle is not a DP release; compose multiple releases

final.bootstrap: 10000 paired patient-cluster draws, carry all images and multiplicities
final.seed_aggregation: mean of per-seed metrics, not prediction ensemble
final.training_randomness: report separately from conditional patient bootstrap
final.Emphysema: no efficacy endpoint without separately frozen output; seven positives descriptive only

unresolved_before_execution: new latent tensors/SHA and previous-seed exclusion
unresolved_before_final: final synthesis count and independent banks
DP training repetitions and release composition
